question: Swati can do a piece of work in 60 days. He worked on it for 12 days and then Yogi completed it in 24 days. How much time will they take together to complete the work?
solution:
given:

Swati can do a piece of work in 60 days

he worked on it for 12 days

Yogi completed the remaining work in 24 days

Formula Used:

total work = time x efficiency

Calculation:

Let total work = x

Swati can do a work = 60 days

Efficiency of Swati (in one day) = Total work / Time taken = (x)/(60) 

Total work done by Swati in 12 days = Time x Efficiency = 12 x (x)/(60)= <span class=&
